{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {df_grouped['sample_seq'].max()}")"}
